questions.question: What does Claude do in plan mode?

options.text: It investigates and proposes a plan, but doesn’t change files
options.explanation: Correct. You read the plan and decide whether to build it.

options.text: It builds everything as fast as possible
options.explanation: Quite the opposite: nothing is built yet in plan mode.
Plan mode doesn’t delete anything. It’s planning before doing.

questions.question: Which keys do you press to switch to plan mode in Claude Code?

options.explanation: Not this one. You switch modes with the key combination Shift+Tab.
Exactly. Press it until it says plan mode at the bottom.
Enter sends the message. You switch modes with the key combination Shift+Tab.
